description: The build defaults of a .NET repository (warnings as errors, latest-all analyzers, nullable, banned APIs, the analyzer rules) and architecture guards for its xUnit tests (layers, project references, rules for types, names and files), with the exceptions of suwgate.yml.
Database guards for the xUnit tests of a .NET application (migration scripts, SQL), with the exceptions of suwgate.yml.
Optional Mesa lavapipe fallback for Goo on Windows x64 and Linux x64.

Lightweight, AOT-compatible cross-platform secret storage for .NET with native OS keyring access (Windows Credential Manager, macOS/iOS Keychain, Linux libsecret, Android Keystore) and encrypted file fallback.
LZ4 native runtime for linux-musl-arm64 (Alpine and other musl distributions).
LZ4 native runtime for linux-musl-x64 (Alpine and other musl distributions).
Zstandard native runtime for linux-musl-arm64 (Alpine and other musl distributions).
Zstandard native runtime for linux-musl-x64 (Alpine and other musl distributions).
Dotenv configuration files with explicit key mappings and standard .NET host integration.
